progression.narrative: The performance opens on C4 and dwells most on C in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:08.4) introduces C, centred on C. Phrase 8 (1:24.5) introduces F, centred on C. Phrase 9 (1:41.7) introduces G, centred on C. Phrase 16 (3:25.2) introduces Bk, centred on C. Phrase 18 (3:47.1) introduces E, centred on C. Phrase 19 (3:58.1) introduces D, centred on D. Phrase 32 (6:20.2) introduces Ak, centred on G. Phrase 36 (7:20.1) introduces A, centred on C. The line peaks at A4 (453.2 Hz) at 7:20.5. It closes on the tonic (G4 → F4 → E4 → C3 → C3 → C4).
